name: birds of blood and snow
source:
After learning of the 'Snowpocalypse' via Mion's blog, Yuuki holes up with him in a bunker to survive. But the snow doesn't seem to be stopping. At all.

[From [url=https://wondereater.itch.io/birdsofbloodandsnow]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
通过Mion的博客得知“雪灾”后，Yuuki和他一起躲在地堡里求生。但雪似乎还没有停的意思。完全没有。

[来自[url=https://wondereater.itch.io/birdsofbloodandsnow]itch.io[/url]]
